name: Air Force One
description: Follow Air Force One, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump Says New Air Force One Will Be Taken Out of Service to Be ‘Maxed Out’
changes.summary: The Qatari-donated plane has been under scrutiny over whether it is fitted with sufficient defensive capabilities to adequately protect a U.S. president and others traveling on it.

changes.title: Trump says new Air Force One will be sent away for upgrades, amid security concerns
changes.summary: President Trump said the Air Force One plane that was donated by Qatar will be sent away for upgrades, amid swirling concerns about its security features.

changes.title: The Evolution of Presidential Travel: Horse Carriages to Air Force One
changes.summary: From horse-drawn presidential coaches to Air Force One, presidents have used various modes of transportation to project an image of America for nearly 250 years.

changes.title: New York Times files motion to quash subpoenas served on journalists over Air Force One coverage
changes.summary: The New York Times on Wednesday filed a motion to quash subpoenas that the Justice Department served on journalists who reported on security concerns involving the new, Qatari-gifted Air Force One, teeing up a significant court fight pitting press freedom against the the government's ability to force reporters to ident.

changes.title: New York Times Files Motion to Quash Subpoenas of Its Journalists
changes.summary: The Justice Department is seeking to compel grand jury testimony as part of an investigation into Times reporting on the president’s new Air Force One jet.

changes.title: Investigators Seek Information From Government Officials as Part of Air Force One Leak Investigation
changes.summary: After The New York Times reported on security concerns related to the Qatari-donated jet, the F.B.I. sought to speak with several people who flew aboard the plane with President Trump last week and asked for their phones.

changes.title: Subpoenas over New York Times report on Air Force One raise press freedom concerns
changes.summary: Several New York Times reporters were subpoenaed to appear before a federal grand jury after the paper published stories raising security concerns about the new Air Force One. White House correspondent Liz Landers discusses questions the case is raising about freedom of the press with Will Creeley.
